_comment: Curated reference repos for TraderTracker. This is INTENT, not verified fact. None of these were reachable from the session that created this file (org egress policy blocks GitHub; the GitHub integration is scoped to devon-smith/* only; add_repo is same-owner only). 'verified' stays false until scripts/fetch_references.sh clones the repo successfully and records its SHA in references/pinned.txt. Do NOT treat any 'claim' field as confirmed, and do NOT vendor code from any repo with security_audit_required=true until it has been audited line-by-line.

execution_only_kalshi._comment: Kalshi has NO trader-tracking tooling because the data does not exist publicly. These are execution/market-making bots only — relevant if Kalshi ever becomes an execution venue (out of scope for the tracking project). Listed for completeness; not part of the core build.
